## Purpose
This is the Claude Code hooks subsystem; it owns the two event-driven scripts that fire at runtime to keep documentation fresh and inject context correctly across session boundaries.

## Map
- PR-triggered doc refresh → `auto-docs-refresh.mjs` · `isPrCommand`, `workdirFromCommand`, `docPathsFromStatus`, `docgenCandidates`, `sysregCandidates`
- Dedup-state reset on compaction/new session → `reset-inject-dedup.mjs` · `candidatePaths`, `resetDedup`
- Hook wiring (plugin-root-relative paths, for `plugin.json` consumers) → `hooks.json`
- Hook wiring (host-repo-relative paths, for `install.sh` merge target) → `settings.json`
- Tests → `auto-docs-refresh.test.mjs`, `reset-inject-dedup.test.mjs`

## Dependencies / collaborators
- `../docgen/inject-readme-context.mjs` — the inject hook whose dedup file `reset-inject-dedup.mjs` clears
- `../systems-registry/inject.mjs` — the other inject hook whose dedup file is cleared
- `../docgen/docgen` and `../systems-registry/cli.mjs` — binaries invoked by `auto-docs-refresh.mjs` (also probes host-repo copies under `tools/`)
- `../telemetry/writer.mjs` — best-effort event sink used by both hooks

## Gotchas
- `auto-docs-refresh.mjs` spawns a fully detached worker for all I/O work and exits immediately; the actual docgen/commit/push happens asynchronously in `/tmp/auto-docs-refresh.log`. A per-HEAD-sha marker (`<gitdir>/auto-docs-refresh.sha`) prevents double-runs; a lockfile prevents overlapping workers.
- `reset-inject-dedup.mjs` must mirror the exact filename conventions of both inject scripts (docgen sanitizes session_id chars; systems-registry uses the raw value) — divergence causes silent dedup-file leaks after compaction.
- `hooks.json` uses `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` (plugin mode); `settings.json` uses `tools/codecontext/` (vendored mode). They are not interchangeable — merging the wrong one into a host repo's `.claude/settings.json` will silently mis-route all hook commands.
